trait.name: Web of the Verdant Lie
entries: Green dragons understand that controlling what someone believes is often more useful than controlling their body. They collect promises, weaknesses, fears, alliances, and secrets with the same appetite other dragons reserve for gold. At great age, simply dealing with one becomes dangerous long before initiative is rolled.

entries.name: Borrowed Voice
entries: Reproducing a learned voice or sound requires an Action. The dragon remembers the learned voice or sound indefinitely. After hearing a voice or sound for at least 1 minute, the dragon can reproduce it. A creature suspicious of the imitation can make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check against the dragon's Spell Save DC. This doesn't provide perfect supernatural identity copying.

entries.name: Venomous Bargain
entries: This effect lasts for 24 hours. When a creature willingly makes an explicit promise to the dragon, the dragon can mystically mark that promise. If the dragon later actually learns that the creature knowingly broke the promise during the duration, it can trigger the mark. The creature takes {@damage 4d8} Poison plus {@damage 4d8} Psychic damage, and the dragon knows its direction for 1 hour while both remain on the same plane. This isn't perfect lie detection; the dragon must genuinely learn that the promise was broken.

entries.name: Web of Influence
entries: After speaking with a creature for at least 1 minute, the dragon can make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check opposed by the creature's Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. On a success, the dragon learns one broad current reasonably exposed by the creature's behavior: a fear, desire, important loyalty, or immediate goal. This doesn't reveal memories or perfectly hidden truths.

entries.name: Forest of False Paths
entries: In natural vegetation, forest, swamp, or jungle, the dragon leaves no trail unless it chooses, can't be tracked nonmagically, and can move through nonmagical plants without slowing. A creature tracking the dragon can be deliberately led onto a false route unless it succeeds on a Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

entries.name: Every Promise Has Teeth
entries: Once per turn, when a creature affected by one of the wyrm's Enchantment spells, Illusion spells, Charmed effects, or Venomous Bargains damages the wyrm or knowingly acts directly against an instruction it accepted, that creature takes {@damage 8d10} Poison or Psychic damage (the wyrm's choice). The creature also can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the dragon more than size. Its voice, gaze, posture, and supernatural presence carry the instinctive certainty of an apex creature that has survived centuries. Those who stand before it can feel that history pressing against their courage. At the start of its turn, the dragon can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 300 feet that can see or hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the dragon for 1 minute. The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 8d10 + 10} Piercing damage plus {@damage 8d8} Fire damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 8d6 + 10} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 35 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 8d8 + 10} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 8d6 + 10} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 4}
entries: The wyrm exhales its breath weapon in a 120-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 27} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 32d6} Fire damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. Wyrm Fire Supremacy applies to this Fire damage.

action.name: Worldfire
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 19} to hit, range 500 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 16d12} Fire damage. This attack is magical and counts as a spell attack, but isn't itself a spell.

legendaryHeader: The wyrm can take 7 Legendary Actions, choosing from the options below. Only one Legendary Action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The wyrm regains spent Legendary Actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The wyrm makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The wyrm makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The wyrm makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Cast Cantrip
entries: The wyrm casts one cantrip.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 25 feet of the wyrm must make a {@dc 27} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 8d6 + 10} Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn't fall Prone. The wyrm can then fly up to half its Fly Speed.

legendary.name: Cataclysmic Movement (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The wyrm moves up to its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature the wyrm passes within 20 feet of during this movement must succeed on a {@dc 27} Dexterity Saving Throw or fall Prone.

legendary.name: Cast Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The wyrm casts one spell of 7th level or lower that normally has a casting time of 1 Action, expending a spell slot or use as normal.

legendary.name: Breath Surge (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The wyrm rolls one additional d6 to recharge Fire Breath. If Fire Breath is already available, the wyrm can instead immediately use Fire Breath.

legendary.name: High Magic (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The wyrm casts one spell from Draconic High Magic whose use is still available.

conditionImmune.note: from effects other than being reduced to 0 Hit Points

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (9/Day)
entries: If the greatwyrm fails a Saving Throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Draconic Magic
entries: {@b Greatwyrm Magic Resistance.} The greatwyrm has Advantage on Saving Throws against spells and other magical effects. Spell attack rolls against the greatwyrm are made with Disadvantage.
{@b Perfect Concentration.} The greatwyrm automatically succeeds on Constitution Saving Throws made to maintain Concentration as a result of taking damage.
{@b Innate Elemental Casting.} When the greatwyrm casts a spell whose primary damage type is Cold, it can cast that spell without Verbal, Somatic, or non-costly Material components.

{@b Greatwyrm Cold Supremacy.} The greatwyrm's Cold damage ignores Resistance and Immunity to Cold damage. An effect that would absorb, redirect, convert, or turn the greatwyrm's Cold damage into healing can't do so. The damage is dealt normally instead. Effects that reduce damage without depending on its damage type function normally.
{@b Perfect High Magic Recovery.} At the end of a Short Rest, the greatwyrm regains one expended use of Draconic High Magic. This can restore an expended use of a 9th-level spell.
{@b Arcane Reclamation.} At the end of a Short Rest, the greatwyrm can recover expended spell slots whose combined spell levels don't exceed 30. It can't recover uses of Draconic High Magic this way.

{@b Draconic Spell List.} Draconic magic grows from instinct and experience. The greatwyrm knows every spell in the White Dragon Spell List through 9th-level magic, as presented in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait.

{@b Draconic At-Will Magic.} The greatwyrm can cast each spell listed under At Will in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait without expending a spell slot and with no usage limit. A leveled spell cast this way is cast at its lowest spell level. The greatwyrm can instead expend a spell slot to cast that spell normally, including to upcast it when applicable. An At-Will spell with a Casting Time of 1 Action can replace the greatwyrm's one permitted spell replacement in Multiattack. trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the greatwyrm ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The greatwyrm magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 33 or lower, or returns to its true form.

While transformed, it retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; Saving Throw and Skill proficiencies; languages; personality and memories; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Legendary Resistance; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body. It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics.

It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The greatwyrm can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The greatwyrm can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell cone of cold|XPHB}, {@spell wall of ice|XPHB}, {@spell forcecage|XPHB}, {@spell control weather|XPHB}, {@spell foresight|XPHB}, {@spell time stop|XPHB}, {@spell shapechange|XPHB}, and {@spell wish|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the greatwyrm from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. When cast through Draconic High Magic, the spell doesn't require Material components unless they have a listed cost or are consumed.

trait.name: The Last Winter (1/Long Rest)
entries: When the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead, it regains all of its Hit Points; ends any conditions or ongoing effects on itself that it chooses; recharges its Cold Breath; regains all expended uses of Legendary Resistance; regains all expended uses of Draconic High Magic; and immediately regains its full allotment of Legendary Actions. For 1 hour, the greatwyrm enters The Last Winter.

A supernatural freezing storm extends 300 feet from the greatwyrm and moves with it. The area is Difficult Terrain for creatures of the greatwyrm's choice. At the start of each creature's turn within the area, the greatwyrm can choose for that creature to take {@damage 6d10} Cold damage. Greatwyrm Cold Supremacy applies to this damage. Nonmagical flames within the area are extinguished. At the start of each of the greatwyrm's turns, its Cold Breath automatically recharges.
While The Last Winter is active, the greatwyrm can use its Mythic Actions.

trait.name: Memory of the Endless Hunt
entries: White dragons may be less scholarly than their kin, but the hunt is a language they understand with terrifying clarity. Tracks, scents, wounds, habits, and escape routes become parts of a living map in the dragon's mind. Once an elder white dragon decides something is prey, distance becomes a temporary inconvenience.

entries.name: Chosen Prey
entries: The greatwyrm must spend 1 minute observing a creature, its scent, or its tracks to use this feature. The effect lasts until replaced. The dragon marks one creature as its Chosen Prey. It has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) and Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks made to locate or track that creature. While within 1 mile, if there is a physical trail or scent the dragon could reasonably detect, it knows the trail's general direction.

entries.name: Relentless Pursuit
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. The dragon moves up to half its Speed toward its Chosen Prey. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks from the Chosen Prey, and snow and ice don't cost the dragon extra movement during it.

entries.name: Learn the Prey's Pattern
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. This effect lasts until the end of the dragon's next turn. After its Chosen Prey hits the dragon with an attack or causes the dragon to fail a Saving Throw, the dragon gains a bonus equal to its PB to AC or Saving Throws, as appropriate, against subsequent uses of that same attack or effect by that prey until the end of the dragon's next turn.

entries.name: Frozen Quarry
entries: This effect lasts while the creature remains the dragon's Chosen Prey. A Chosen Prey within 120 feet gains no benefit from being Invisible against the dragon and can't Hide from the dragon using snow, fog, or ice alone. Whenever the dragon deals Cold damage to that creature, its Speed becomes 0 until the start of the dragon's next turn.

entries.name: There Is No Escape
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When the Chosen Prey within 1 mile teleports or magically moves away, the greatwyrm immediately knows its direction, distance, and whether it changed planes. If the prey remains on the same plane, the greatwyrm can immediately move up to its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

entries.name: Nowhere Is Far Enough
entries: While its Chosen Prey is on the same plane of existence, the greatwyrm always knows its direction and distance. This knowledge doesn't require sight, sound, scent, a physical trail, or line of effect. The Chosen Prey can't become Hidden from the greatwyrm, and being Invisible grants it no benefit against the greatwyrm. Whenever the Chosen Prey teleports, is magically transported, or leaves its current plane of existence, the greatwyrm immediately knows what occurred and the plane to which the prey traveled.

When the Chosen Prey teleports or is magically transported, the greatwyrm can use its Reaction to follow. The greatwyrm appears in an unoccupied space of its choice within 60 feet of the prey's destination, even if the destination is on another plane of existence. Running farther merely tells the greatwyrm where to hunt next.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the greatwyrm more than size. Its voice, gaze, posture, and supernatural presence carry the instinctive certainty of a creature that has outlived lesser empires. At the start of its turn, the greatwyrm can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the greatwyrm's choice within 500 feet that can see or hear it must make a {@dc 26} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the greatwyrm for 1 minute.

The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that greatwyrm's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition. A creature that fails its initial Saving Throw also can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

entries: The greatwyrm chooses a point it can see within 180 feet. A supernatural blizzard fills a 60-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point until the start of the greatwyrm's next turn. entries: The greatwyrm moves up to its Fly Speed toward its Chosen Prey without provoking Opportunity Attacks. At the end of this movement, it can make one Bite attack against the Chosen Prey if the prey is within reach.

mythic.name: The Hunt Ends (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm uses Absolute Zero against its Chosen Prey. While Restrained this way, the prey's Speed is 0 and it can't teleport or be magically transported.

entries.name: Mireborn Predator
entries: The dragon ignores Difficult Terrain created by mud, shallow water, swamp, or rotting vegetation. It can Hide while only Lightly Obscured by swamp vegetation, murky water, fog, or ruins.

entries.name: Cruel Ambush
entries: The healing prevention lasts until the start of the dragon's next turn. The dragon can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action while it has suitable concealment. entries.name: Rot Through Everything

This AC reduction stacks with another AC-reducing effect only when that effect explicitly allows it.

entries: One creature within 180 feet must make a {@dc 29} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 8d10} Acid damage, and one magical effect currently increasing its AC or granting it Resistance is suppressed until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and no effect is suppressed. Greatwyrm Acid Supremacy applies to this damage.

mythic.name: Ruin Walks (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. During this movement, it can move through nonmagical objects and structures as if they were Difficult Terrain, destroying the portions through which it passes.

mythic.name: Nothing Remains (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm uses Absolute Dissolution. On a hit, any spell or magical effect of 8th level or lower currently creating a barrier, armor, shield, or protective field on the target also ends.

monster.name: Green Greatwyrm

conditionImmune.note: from effects other than being reduced to 0 Hit Points

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (9/Day)
entries: If the greatwyrm fails a Saving Throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Draconic Magic
entries: {@b Greatwyrm Magic Resistance.} The greatwyrm has Advantage on Saving Throws against spells and other magical effects. Spell attack rolls against the greatwyrm are made with Disadvantage.
{@b Perfect Concentration.} The greatwyrm automatically succeeds on Constitution Saving Throws made to maintain Concentration as a result of taking damage.
{@b Innate Elemental Casting.} When the greatwyrm casts a spell whose primary damage type is Poison, it can cast that spell without Verbal, Somatic, or non-costly Material components.

{@b Greatwyrm Poison Supremacy.} The greatwyrm's Poison damage ignores Resistance and Immunity to Poison damage. An effect that would absorb, redirect, convert, or turn the greatwyrm's Poison damage into healing can't do so. The damage is dealt normally instead. Effects that reduce damage without depending on its damage type function normally.
{@b Perfect High Magic Recovery.} At the end of a Short Rest, the greatwyrm regains one expended use of Draconic High Magic. This can restore an expended use of a 9th-level spell.
{@b Arcane Reclamation.} At the end of a Short Rest, the greatwyrm can recover expended spell slots whose combined spell levels don't exceed 30. It can't recover uses of Draconic High Magic this way.

{@b Draconic Spell List.} Draconic magic grows from instinct and experience. The greatwyrm knows every spell in the Green Dragon Spell List through 9th-level magic, as presented in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait.

{@b Draconic At-Will Magic.} The dragon can cast each spell listed under At Will in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait without expending a spell slot and with no usage limit. A leveled spell cast this way is cast at its lowest spell level. The dragon can instead expend a spell slot to cast that spell normally, including to upcast it when applicable. An At-Will spell with a Casting Time of 1 Action can replace the dragon's one permitted spell replacement in Multiattack, if that dragon has Multiattack. Leveled At-Will Magic at this age: {@spell disguise self|XPHB}, {@spell ray of sickness|XPHB}, {@spell detect thoughts|XPHB}, {@spell suggestion|XPHB}, {@spell hypnotic pattern|XPHB}, {@spell major image|XPHB}, {@spell charm monster|XGE}, {@spell greater invisibility|XPHB}, {@spell mass suggestion|XPHB}, {@spell project image|XPHB}.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the greatwyrm ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The greatwyrm magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 35 or lower, or returns to its true form.

While transformed, it retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; Saving Throw and Skill proficiencies; languages; personality and memories; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Legendary Resistance; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body. It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics.

It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The greatwyrm can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The greatwyrm can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell modify memory|XPHB}, {@spell mass suggestion|XPHB}, {@spell dominate monster|XPHB}, {@spell feeblemind|XPHB}, {@spell psychic scream|XGE}, {@spell shapechange|XPHB}, and {@spell wish|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the greatwyrm from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. When cast through Draconic High Magic, the spell doesn't require Material components unless they have a listed cost or are consumed.

trait.name: The Emerald Masquerade (1/Long Rest)
entries: When the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead, it regains all of its Hit Points; ends any conditions or ongoing effects on itself that it chooses; recharges its Poison Breath; regains all expended uses of Legendary Resistance; regains all expended uses of Draconic High Magic; and immediately regains its full allotment of Legendary Actions. For 1 hour, poisonous hallucinatory mist fills a 300-foot aura around the greatwyrm and moves with it.

At the start of each hostile creature's turn in the aura, the greatwyrm chooses Poison or Psychic. That creature takes {@damage 6d10} damage of the chosen type. Greatwyrm Poison Supremacy applies if the chosen damage is Poison. The first Saving Throw each turn that a hostile creature in the aura makes against one of the greatwyrm's Enchantment or Illusion effects is made with Disadvantage. At the start of each of the greatwyrm's turns, its Poison Breath automatically recharges.
While The Emerald Masquerade is active, the greatwyrm can use its Mythic Actions.

trait.name: Web of the Verdant Lie
entries: Green dragons understand that controlling what someone believes is often more useful than controlling their body. They collect promises, weaknesses, fears, alliances, and secrets with the same appetite other dragons reserve for gold. At great age, simply dealing with one becomes dangerous long before initiative is rolled.

entries.name: Borrowed Voice
entries: Reproducing a learned voice or sound requires an Action. The dragon remembers the learned voice or sound indefinitely. After hearing a voice or sound for at least 1 minute, the dragon can reproduce it. A creature suspicious of the imitation can make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check against the dragon's Spell Save DC. This doesn't provide perfect supernatural identity copying.

entries.name: Venomous Bargain
entries: This effect lasts for 24 hours. When a creature willingly makes an explicit promise to the dragon, the dragon can mystically mark that promise. If the dragon later actually learns that the creature knowingly broke the promise during the duration, it can trigger the mark. The creature takes {@damage 4d8} Poison plus {@damage 4d8} Psychic damage, and the dragon knows its direction for 1 hour while both remain on the same plane. This isn't perfect lie detection; the dragon must genuinely learn that the promise was broken.

entries.name: Web of Influence
entries: After speaking with a creature for at least 1 minute, the dragon can make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check opposed by the creature's Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. On a success, the dragon learns one broad current reasonably exposed by the creature's behavior: a fear, desire, important loyalty, or immediate goal. This doesn't reveal memories or perfectly hidden truths.

entries.name: Forest of False Paths
entries: In natural vegetation, forest, swamp, or jungle, the dragon leaves no trail unless it chooses, can't be tracked nonmagically, and can move through nonmagical plants without slowing. A creature tracking the dragon can be deliberately led onto a false route unless it succeeds on a Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

entries.name: Every Promise Has Teeth
entries: Once per turn, when a creature affected by one of the greatgreatwyrm's Enchantment spells, Illusion spells, Charmed effects, or Venomous Bargains damages the greatwyrm or knowingly acts directly against an instruction it accepted, that creature takes {@damage 8d10} Poison or Psychic damage (the greatgreatwyrm's choice). The creature also can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: The Lie You Live By
entries: Whenever a creature fails a Saving Throw against one of the greatwyrm's Enchantment spells, Illusion spells, Charmed effects, or Venomous Bargains, it becomes Webbound for 24 hours. While both are on the same plane, the greatwyrm knows the direction and distance to a Webbound creature. A Webbound creature has Disadvantage on Saving Throws against the greatwyrm's Enchantment and Illusion spells. Once per turn, when a Webbound creature knowingly acts directly against an instruction, bargain, promise, or course of action it previously accepted from the greatwyrm, it takes {@damage 10d10} Poison or Psychic damage, chosen by the greatwyrm.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the greatwyrm more than size. Its voice, gaze, posture, and supernatural presence carry the instinctive certainty of a creature that has outlived lesser empires. At the start of its turn, the greatwyrm can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the greatwyrm's choice within 500 feet that can see or hear it must make a {@dc 28} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the greatwyrm for 1 minute.

The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that greatwyrm's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition. A creature that fails its initial Saving Throw also can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Innate Draconic Spellcasting
headerEntries: The greatwyrm's spellcasting ability is Charisma. Its spell save DC is 28, and it has +20 to hit with spell attacks. It requires no Spellcasting Focus. It can perform Somatic components using its draconic body. It doesn't require Material components that have no listed cost and aren't consumed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The greatwyrm makes six attacks using any combination of its Bite, Claw, and Tail. The greatwyrm can replace only one of these attacks with the casting of a spell that normally has a Casting Time of 1 Action. The spell is resolved normally and expends a spell slot or use as normal. A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 21} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d10 + 11} Piercing damage plus {@damage 10d8} Poison damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 21} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6 + 11} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 21} to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d8 + 11} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 21} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6 + 11} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Poison Breath {@recharge 3}
entries: The greatwyrm exhales its breath weapon in a 180-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 29} Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 40d6} Poison damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. A creature that fails the save is also Poisoned until the end of its next turn. Greatwyrm Poison Supremacy applies to this Poison damage.

action.name: Sovereign Toxin
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 20} to hit, range 600 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 20d12} Poison damage. The target must make a {@dc 28} Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, until the end of its next turn it has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, and Saving Throws; can't take Reactions; and its Speed becomes 0. This attack is magical and counts as a spell attack, but isn't itself a spell. Greatwyrm Poison Supremacy applies to this damage.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The greatwyrm makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Cast Cantrip
entries: The greatwyrm casts one cantrip.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the greatwyrm must make a {@dc 29} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d6 + 11} Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn't fall Prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its Fly Speed.

legendary.name: Cataclysmic Movement (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm moves up to its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature the greatwyrm passes within 25 feet of during this movement must succeed on a {@dc 29} Dexterity Saving Throw or fall Prone.

legendary.name: Cast Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm casts one spell of 8th level or lower that normally has a Casting Time of 1 Action, expending a spell slot or use as normal.

legendary.name: Sovereign Toxin (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm uses Sovereign Toxin.

legendary.name: Breath Surge (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm rolls one additional d6 to recharge Poison Breath. If Poison Breath is already available, the greatwyrm can instead immediately use Poison Breath.

legendary.name: High Magic (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm casts one spell from Draconic High Magic whose use is still available.

entries: The greatwyrm teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. An illusory duplicate remains where it departed until the start of its next turn. Until then, the first attack roll made against the greatwyrm has Disadvantage.

entries: The greatwyrm casts an Enchantment or Illusion spell of 6th level or lower that normally has a Casting Time of 1 Action, expending no spell slot.

entries: One Webbound creature within 300 feet must make a {@dc 28} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the greatwyrm chooses whether the creature immediately uses its Reaction to move up to its Speed or make one weapon or Unarmed Strike attack against a target the greatwyrm chooses.

trait.name: Throne of the Storm
entries: Blue dragons regard the sky as a throne and the horizon as the boundary of their court. Mirage, thunder, sand, and lightning blur together around their territories. Eventually the weather ceases to be something surrounding the dragon and becomes something obeying it.

entries.name: Mirage of the Wastes
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for up to 1 hour. The dragon creates a harmless visual or auditory mirage within 60 feet occupying no more than a 10-foot Cube. Physical interaction reveals that it isn't real. The dragon also ignores natural penalties caused by extreme heat and blowing sand.

entries.name: Static Step
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When the dragon is targeted by an attack, it can move up to 20 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If this movement changes whether the attack can legally reach it, the attack is resolved using the dragon's new position. The dragon can use this Reaction a number of times equal to its PB per Long Rest.

entries.name: Storm Dominion
entries: The dragon emits a 60-foot aura. Hostile creatures treat flying movement in the aura as Difficult Terrain. Hostile creatures also have Disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks made through more than 20 feet of the aura. The dragon chooses whether the effect visibly manifests as wind, sand, static, or clear storm pressure.

entries.name: Thunder Answers Defiance

entries.name: The Sky Belongs to Me

{@b Arcane Reclamation.} At the end of a Short Rest, the greatwyrm can recover expended spell slots whose combined spell levels don't exceed 30. It can't recover uses of Draconic High Magic this way.

{@b Draconic Spell List.} Draconic magic grows from instinct and experience. The greatwyrm knows every spell in the Red Dragon Spell List through 9th-level magic, as presented in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait.

{@b Draconic At-Will Magic.} The dragon can cast each spell listed under At Will in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait without expending a spell slot and with no usage limit. A leveled spell cast this way is cast at its lowest spell level. The dragon can instead expend a spell slot to cast that spell normally, including to upcast it when applicable. An At-Will spell with a Casting Time of 1 Action can replace the dragon's one permitted spell replacement in Multiattack, if that dragon has Multiattack. Leveled At-Will Magic at this age: {@spell detect magic|XPHB}, {@spell burning hands|XPHB}, {@spell scorching ray|XPHB}, {@spell see invisibility|XPHB}, {@spell fireball|XPHB}, {@spell dispel magic|XPHB}, {@spell wall of fire|XPHB}, {@spell immolation|XGE}, {@spell disintegrate|XPHB}, {@spell delayed blast fireball|XPHB}.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the greatwyrm ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The greatwyrm magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 37 or lower, or returns to its true form.

While transformed, it retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; Saving Throw and Skill proficiencies; languages; personality and memories; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Legendary Resistance; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body. It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics.

It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The greatwyrm can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The greatwyrm can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell disintegrate|XPHB}, {@spell delayed blast fireball|XPHB}, {@spell incendiary cloud|XPHB}, {@spell meteor swarm|XPHB}, {@spell power word kill|XPHB}, {@spell time stop|XPHB}, and {@spell wish|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the greatwyrm from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. When cast through Draconic High Magic, the spell doesn't require Material components unless they have a listed cost or are consumed.

trait.name: The Burning Crown (1/Long Rest)
entries: When the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead, it regains all of its Hit Points; ends any conditions or ongoing effects on itself that it chooses; recharges its Fire Breath; regains all expended uses of Legendary Resistance; regains all expended uses of Draconic High Magic; and immediately regains its full allotment of Legendary Actions. For 1 hour, an aura of sovereign flame extends 300 feet from the greatwyrm and moves with it.

At the start of each hostile creature's turn in the aura, that creature takes {@damage 6d10} Fire damage. Greatwyrm Fire Supremacy applies to this damage. Whenever the greatwyrm rolls Fire damage, it treats any 1, 2, or 3 on a damage die as a 4. At the start of each of the greatwyrm's turns, its Fire Breath automatically recharges. While The Burning Crown is active, the greatwyrm can use its Mythic Actions.

trait.name: Sovereignty of the Burning Hoard
entries: To a red dragon, possession is not a legal concept but a fact of nature. What it claims becomes part of its identity, and resistance to its authority is treated as a personal insult. With age, the distinction between its treasure, its territory, and the world it believes it deserves begins to disappear.

entries.name: Claimed Treasure
entries: The greatwyrm must touch the object for 1 minute to use this feature. The claim lasts until the dragon willingly releases it. The dragon can mystically mark up to PB × 10 objects as Claimed Treasure. While a Claimed object is on the same plane and within 1 mile, the dragon knows its direction, approximate distance, and whether it is moving. This doesn't reveal who carries the object or grant supernatural vision through it.

entries.name: Tyrant's Challenge
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The dragon chooses one creature within 60 feet. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than the dragon, and the first time on each of its turns that it damages another creature, it takes {@damage 2d8} Fire damage. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Burning Dominion
entries: The dragon emits a 60-foot aura. A hostile creature that starts its turn in the aura while Frightened of the dragon takes Fire damage equal to the dragon's PB + Charisma modifier. Until the start of that creature's next turn, it can't become Invisible and treats movement that carries it farther from the dragon as Difficult Terrain.

entries.name: Hoardfire Reprisal
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 120 feet damages the dragon or takes or removes something the dragon has Claimed, the dragon erupts flame around that creature. The creature makes a Dexterity Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC, taking {@damage 6d10} Fire damage and being pushed 30 feet on a failure, or taking half as much damage with no push on a success.

entries.name: All Beneath the Crown
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The greatwyrm creates a 300-foot aura. At the start of each hostile creature's turn in the aura, that creature must make a Charisma Saving Throw against the greatgreatwyrm's Spell Save DC. On a failed save, until the start of its next turn the creature can't teleport, can't become Invisible, can't willingly move farther from the greatwyrm, and can't carry a Claimed Treasure farther away from it.

entries.name: The World Is Mine
entries: Whenever All Beneath the Crown is active, its radius becomes 500 feet. Every unattended object and structure in the aura is considered Claimed Treasure for the purpose of the greatwyrm's features. A hostile creature that fails the Saving Throw against All Beneath the Crown can't teleport, become Invisible, willingly move farther from the greatwyrm, or remove a Claimed object farther from it. In addition, the first time each turn such a creature damages the greatwyrm or attempts to take, destroy, move, or magically alter something the greatwyrm has Claimed, it takes {@damage 10d10} Fire damage.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the greatwyrm more than size. Its voice, gaze, posture, and supernatural presence carry the instinctive certainty of a creature that has outlived lesser empires. At the start of its turn, the greatwyrm can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the greatwyrm's choice within 500 feet that can see or hear it must make a {@dc 30} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the greatwyrm for 1 minute.

The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that greatwyrm's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition. A creature that fails its initial Saving Throw also can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Innate Draconic Spellcasting
headerEntries: The greatwyrm's spellcasting ability is Charisma. Its spell save DC is 30, and it has +22 to hit with spell attacks. It requires no Spellcasting Focus. It can perform Somatic components using its draconic body. It doesn't require Material components that have no listed cost and aren't consumed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The greatwyrm makes six attacks using any combination of its Bite, Claw, and Tail. The greatwyrm can replace only one of these attacks with the casting of a spell that normally has a Casting Time of 1 Action. The spell is resolved normally and expends a spell slot or use as normal. A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 22} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d10 + 11} Piercing damage plus {@damage 10d8} Fire damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 22} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6 + 11} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 22} to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d8 + 11} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 22} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6 + 11} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 3}
entries: The greatwyrm exhales its breath weapon in a 180-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 30} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 40d6} Fire damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. A creature that fails the save also burns until the end of its next turn, taking {@damage 6d10} Fire damage at the start of its turn. Greatwyrm Fire Supremacy applies to this Fire damage.

action.name: Worldfire
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 22} to hit, range 800 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 20d12} Fire damage. On a hit, each creature other than the target within 20 feet of it must make a {@dc 30} Dexterity Saving Throw, taking {@damage 8d10} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. This attack is magical and counts as a spell attack, but isn't itself a spell. Greatwyrm Fire Supremacy applies to this damage.

legendaryHeader: The greatwyrm can take 9 Legendary Actions, choosing from the options below. Only one Legendary Action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The greatwyrm regains spent Legendary Actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The greatwyrm makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Cast Cantrip
entries: The greatwyrm casts one cantrip.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the greatwyrm must make a {@dc 30} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d6 + 11} Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn't fall Prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its Fly Speed.

legendary.name: Cataclysmic Movement (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm moves up to its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature the greatwyrm passes within 25 feet of during this movement must succeed on a {@dc 30} Dexterity Saving Throw or fall Prone.

legendary.name: Cast Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm casts one spell of 8th level or lower that normally has a Casting Time of 1 Action, expending a spell slot or use as normal.

legendary.name: Worldfire (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm uses Worldfire.

legendary.name: Breath Surge (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm rolls one additional d6 to recharge Fire Breath. If Fire Breath is already available, the greatwyrm can instead immediately use Fire Breath.

legendary.name: High Magic (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm casts one spell from Draconic High Magic whose use is still available.

mythicHeader: While The Burning Crown is active, the greatwyrm can use the following Mythic Actions as additional Legendary Action options. They expend Legendary Actions from the greatwyrm's normal pool.

mythic.name: Imperial Reprisal (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm chooses one creature within 300 feet that damaged it since the end of its previous turn. That creature takes {@damage 8d10} Fire damage. Greatwyrm Fire Supremacy applies to this damage.

mythic.name: Kneel (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Each hostile creature of the greatwyrm's choice within 120 feet must make a {@dc 30} Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature falls Prone, its Speed becomes 0, and it can't take Reactions until the end of its next turn.

mythic.name: Burn the Rebellious (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm immediately uses Fire Breath. Creatures currently affected by All Beneath the Crown make the Saving Throw against this use with Disadvantage.

trait.name: Draconic Nature
entries: {@b Young Mind, Ancient Blood.} The dragon is fully sapient but still a child. It can speak, reason, learn, negotiate, deceive, understand consequences, and make simple plans. It lacks the experience, restraint, long-term judgment, and accumulated expertise of older dragons and isn't automatically a scholar, mastermind, or expert caster.

{@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The dragon is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. This trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.
{@b Keen Senses.} The dragon has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.
{@b No Change Shape.} This wyrmling doesn't possess Change Shape. Metallic dragons of this lineage begin developing Change Shape at the Young age category.

trait.name: Voice of the Open Horizon
entries: Brass dragons have always treated conversation as something more powerful than claws. Their voices carry intent, emotion, warning, humor, and authority far beyond ordinary speech. As they age, even violence can be interrupted by the simple fact that a Brass Dragon has chosen to speak.

entries.name: Tongue Without Borders
entries: Any creature within 60 feet that knows at least one language can understand the Brass Dragon's spoken words, regardless of what language the dragon actually uses. The dragon similarly understands the general meaning of spoken language it hears, though this doesn't decipher codes, secret meanings, or magically concealed information.

entries: {@b Young Mind, Ancient Blood.} The dragon is fully sapient but still a child. It can speak, reason, learn, negotiate, deceive, understand consequences, and make simple plans. trait.name: Crown of the First Dawn
entries: Gold dragons carry something older than rulership and brighter than ordinary flame. Their presence makes courage easier, deception harder, and cruelty far more dangerous. As a Gold Dragon matures, its authority ceases to feel political and begins to feel cosmic.

entries.name: Dawnfire
entries: Whenever the dragon deals Fire damage, it can choose for any portion of that damage to become Radiant damage instead. Whenever it deals both Fire and Radiant damage to the same target during its turn, that target sheds Bright Light for 10 feet until the start of the dragon's next turn. trait.name: Draconic Nature
entries: {@b Growing Draconic Mind.} The dragon is no longer merely a gifted child. Experience has begun turning instinct into judgment, curiosity into expertise, and power into deliberate technique. It can now pursue plans that last months or years rather than moments. A Young Metallic Dragon can plan ahead, study magic, make agreements, manage territory, and understand social structures far better than a wyrmling, though it still lacks the accumulated experience of an Adult Dragon.

{@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The dragon is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. Its growing experience makes it more reliable than a wyrmling, but this trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.
{@b Keen Senses.} The dragon has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The dragon can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the dragon ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The dragon magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 13 or lower, or returns to its true form. The assumed form can be any Size the chosen creature normally possesses.

While transformed, the dragon retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; personality and memories; alignment; Saving Throw proficiencies; Skill proficiencies; languages; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Draconic Magical Instinct; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body.

It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics, including Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Armor Class, movement modes, natural weapons, physical senses, and other body-dependent traits and actions. It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The dragon can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.
Equipment it is wearing or carrying can merge into the new form or remain usable, as the dragon chooses when it transforms.

trait.name: Draconic Magic
entries: {@b Innate Elemental Casting.} When the dragon casts a spell whose primary damage type is Fire, it can cast that spell without Verbal, Somatic, or non-costly Material components.
{@b Arcane Reclamation.} At the end of a Short Rest, the dragon can recover expended spell slots whose combined spell levels don't exceed 5. It can't recover uses of Draconic High Magic this way.

{@b Draconic Spell List.} Draconic magic grows from instinct and experience. The dragon knows every spell in the Gold Dragon Spell List through 7-level magic, as presented in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait.

{@b Draconic At-Will Magic.} The dragon can cast each spell listed under At Will in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait without expending a spell slot and with no usage limit. A leveled spell cast this way is cast at its lowest spell level. The dragon can instead expend a spell slot to cast that spell normally, including to upcast it when applicable. An At-Will spell with a Casting Time of 1 Action can replace the dragon's one permitted spell replacement in Multiattack. Leveled At-Will Magic at this age: {@spell detect magic|XPHB}, {@spell command|XPHB}, {@spell scorching ray|XPHB}, {@spell zone of truth|XPHB}.
{@b Gold Fire Affinity.} The dragon's spells ignore Fire Resistance. Fire Immunity still functions normally against the dragon's spells.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The dragon can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell flame strike|XPHB}, {@spell heal|XPHB}, {@spell resurrection|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the dragon from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. When cast through Draconic High Magic, the spell doesn't require Material components unless they have a listed cost or are consumed.

trait.name: Crown of the First Dawn
entries: Gold dragons carry something older than rulership and brighter than ordinary flame. Their presence makes courage easier, deception harder, and cruelty far more dangerous. As a Gold Dragon matures, its authority ceases to feel political and begins to feel cosmic.

entries.name: Dawnfire
entries: Whenever the dragon deals Fire damage, it can choose for any portion of that damage to become Radiant damage instead. Whenever it deals both Fire and Radiant damage to the same target during its turn, that target sheds Bright Light for 10 feet until the start of the dragon's next turn. This doesn't automatically reveal an Invisible creature, but it visibly marks the space occupied by a target that was actually hit.

entries.name: Radiant Authority
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon chooses one creature within 60 feet. That creature becomes Judged. Once per turn, when the Judged creature damages another creature, willingly breaks a promise it made to the dragon during this duration, or attempts to harm a creature the dragon explicitly placed under its protection, the dragon can deal {@damage 2d8} + its Charisma modifier Radiant damage to the Judged creature without using an Action. trait.name: Voice of the Open Horizon
entries: Brass dragons have always treated conversation as something more powerful than claws. Their voices carry intent, emotion, warning, humor, and authority far beyond ordinary speech. As they age, even violence can be interrupted by the simple fact that a Brass Dragon has chosen to speak.

entries.name: Tongue Without Borders
entries: Any creature within 60 feet that knows at least one language can understand the Brass Dragon's spoken words, regardless of what language the dragon actually uses. The dragon similarly understands the general meaning of spoken language it hears, though this doesn't decipher codes, secret meanings, or magically concealed information.

entries.name: Words Before Violence
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Reaction. This effect lasts until the start of the triggering creature's next turn. When a creature within 60 feet that can hear the dragon makes an Attack Roll, the dragon can speak a warning, argument, insult, plea, or distraction. The creature makes a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC. On a failure, it has Disadvantage on that attack, can't make Opportunity Attacks, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Command the Conversation
entries: The dragon can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Creatures of the dragon's choice within 120 feet that can hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC. On a failure, a creature can't willingly attack the dragon or a creature designated by the dragon until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Taking damage from a protected creature immediately allows another save. This effect isn't Charmed and functions against creatures immune to Charmed.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the dragon more than size. Its voice, gaze, posture, and supernatural presence carry the instinctive certainty of an apex creature that has survived centuries. Those who stand before it can feel that history pressing against their courage. At the start of its turn, the dragon can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet that can see or hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

entries: Copper dragons rarely accept the world exactly as they find it. Stone becomes a stage, distance becomes a joke, and certainty becomes something to be mocked. With age, reality itself seems increasingly willing to participate in the dragon's tricks.

entries: The dragon can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell chain lightning|XPHB}, {@spell control weather|XPHB}, {@spell storm of vengeance|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the dragon from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. When cast through Draconic High Magic, the spell doesn't require Material components unless they have a listed cost or are consumed.

trait.name: Stormwarden's Instinct
entries: Bronze dragons possess an almost compulsive awareness of danger around them. Thunder answers not merely anger, but the decision to stand between harm and another creature. An elder Bronze Dragon doesn't simply endure a battlefield—it controls who is allowed to be hurt within it.

entries.name: Protective Instinct
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 30 feet is hit by an attack, the dragon can impose a penalty equal to its PB on the triggering attack roll, potentially causing it to miss.

entries.name: Storm Interception
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 60 feet is targeted by an attack, the dragon can move up to half its Speed toward that creature without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If physically possible, the dragon places itself between the attacker and target and becomes the target of the attack instead. If the attack hits the dragon, the attacker takes Lightning damage equal to PB × 1d8.

entries.name: Guardian of the Storm
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 120 feet fails a Saving Throw against a spell or magical effect, the dragon can allow it to reroll the Saving Throw. If the reroll succeeds, lightning strikes the source of the effect, dealing {@damage 4d10} Lightning damage to it.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the dragon more than size. Its voice, gaze, posture, and supernatural presence carry the instinctive certainty of an apex creature that has survived centuries. Those who stand before it can feel that history pressing against their courage. At the start of its turn, the dragon can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet that can see or hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the dragon for 1 minute. The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that dragon's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition.

entries: The dragon makes three attacks using any combination of its Bite, Claw, and Tail. A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 4d10 + 7} Piercing damage plus {@damage 4d8} Lightning damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 4d6 + 7} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 4d8 + 7} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 4d6 + 7} Bludgeoning damage.

entries: The dragon exhales its breath weapon in a 120-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 16d10} Lightning damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

action.name: Repulsion Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales repulsive energy in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 21} Strength Saving Throw. If the creature strikes a solid obstacle before completing that movement, it takes {@damage 4d6} Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The dragon can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the dragon ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The dragon magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 19 or lower, or returns to its true form. The assumed form can be any Size the chosen creature normally possesses.

It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics, including Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Armor Class, movement modes, natural weapons, physical senses, and other body-dependent traits and actions. It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The dragon can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.
Equipment it is wearing or carrying can merge into the new form or remain usable, as the dragon chooses when it transforms.

trait.name: Draconic Magic
entries: {@b Innate Elemental Casting.} When the dragon casts a spell whose primary damage type is Cold, it can cast that spell without Verbal, Somatic, or non-costly Material components.

trait.name: Sanctuary of the Gentle Sky
entries: Silver dragons carry the safety of high mountains and quiet snowfall with them. Their presence turns survival into recovery and fear into calm. The oldest among them can make death itself wait outside the boundaries of their protection.

entries.name: Warmth Beneath the Snow
entries: Creatures chosen by the dragon within 30 feet are protected from natural extreme cold, have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and automatically stabilize after succeeding on one Death Saving Throw.

The dragon can then move that creature up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the dragon can see. The dragon can use this Reaction a number of times equal to its PB per Long Rest.

trait.name: Argent Aegis
entries: Silver dragons are born with an instinctive resistance to hostile magic that goes beyond ordinary draconic durability. Their scales carry a quiet force that catches, diffuses, and turns aside supernatural pressure before it reaches the body beneath. As a silver dragon matures, that instinct develops into one of the strongest natural magical defenses among true dragons.

entries.name: Argent Ward
entries: The dragon has Advantage on Saving Throws against cantrips and spells of 1st level.

entries.name: Spellward Scales

entries: Gold dragons carry something older than rulership and brighter than ordinary flame. Their presence makes courage easier, deception harder, and cruelty far more dangerous. As a Gold Dragon matures, its authority ceases to feel political and begins to feel cosmic.

entries.name: Tongue Without Borders
entries: Any creature within 60 feet that knows at least one language can understand the Brass Dragon's spoken words, regardless of what language the dragon actually uses. entries.name: Words Before Violence

entries.name: Voice Across Kingdoms
entries: The dragon can deliberately project its voice to any location within 10 miles that it knows. Its speech arrives clearly at the chosen location regardless of intervening terrain. The dragon can choose to speak simultaneously through any number of points within that radius and can choose which creatures at those points hear it. This isn't telepathy and doesn't allow a recipient to answer the dragon automatically.

entries: If the dragon fails a Saving Throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Draconic Nature
entries: {@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The dragon is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. This trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The dragon can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the dragon ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The dragon magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 21 or lower, or returns to its true form. The assumed form can be any Size the chosen creature normally possesses.

While transformed, the dragon retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; personality and memories; alignment; Saving Throw proficiencies; Skill proficiencies; languages; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Draconic Magical Instinct; Legendary Resistance; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body.

It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics, including Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Armor Class, movement modes, natural weapons, physical senses, and other body-dependent traits and actions. It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The dragon can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.
Equipment it is wearing or carrying can merge into the new form or remain usable, as the dragon chooses when it transforms.

trait.name: Draconic Magic
entries: {@b Innate Elemental Casting.} When the dragon casts a spell whose primary damage type is Acid, it can cast that spell without Verbal, Somatic, or non-costly Material components.

{@b Ancient Acid Supremacy.} The dragon's Acid damage ignores Acid Resistance. When the dragon deals Acid damage to a creature with Acid Immunity, that Immunity is treated as Acid Resistance, and the dragon then ignores that Resistance. As a result, the dragon's Acid damage affects creatures with Acid Resistance or Acid Immunity without reducing the damage.
{@b Arcane Reclamation.} At the end of a Short Rest, the dragon can recover expended spell slots whose combined spell levels don't exceed 14. It can't recover uses of Draconic High Magic this way.
{@b Draconic Spell List.} Draconic magic grows from instinct and experience. The dragon knows the Copper Dragon spells presented in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait through 9th-level magic.

{@b Draconic At-Will Magic.} The dragon can cast each spell listed under At Will in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait without expending a spell slot and with no usage limit. A leveled spell cast this way is cast at its lowest spell level. The dragon can instead expend a spell slot to cast that spell normally, including to upcast it when applicable. entries.name: Impossible Shortcut

trait.name: Stormwarden's Instinct
entries: Bronze dragons possess an almost compulsive awareness of danger around them. Thunder answers not merely anger, but the decision to stand between harm and another creature. An elder Bronze Dragon doesn't simply endure a battlefield—it controls who is allowed to be hurt within it.

entries.name: Protective Instinct
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 30 feet is hit by an attack, the dragon can impose a penalty equal to its PB on the triggering attack roll, potentially causing it to miss.

entries.name: Storm Interception

If the attack hits the dragon, the attacker takes Lightning damage equal to PB × 1d8.

If the reroll succeeds, lightning strikes the source of the effect, dealing {@damage 4d10} Lightning damage to it.

entries.name: Storm Answers Harm
entries: This effect lasts until the end of the dragon's next turn. Whenever a creature within 120 feet damages one of the dragon's chosen allies, that attacker becomes Storm-Marked until the end of the dragon's next turn. trait.name: Sanctuary of the Gentle Sky
entries: Silver dragons carry the safety of high mountains and quiet snowfall with them. Their presence turns survival into recovery and fear into calm. The oldest among them can make death itself wait outside the boundaries of their protection.

entries.name: Warmth Beneath the Snow
entries: Creatures chosen by the dragon within 30 feet are protected from natural extreme cold, have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and automatically stabilize after succeeding on one Death Saving Throw.

entries.name: Shelter in the Storm

entries.name: Sanctuary Cannot Be Broken
entries: The dragon can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon creates a 120-foot aura. Chosen creatures in the aura have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, can't have their Hit Point maximum reduced, can't be prevented from regaining Hit Points, and can't be instantly killed while above 0 Hit Points.

trait.name: Argent Aegis
entries: Silver dragons are born with an instinctive resistance to hostile magic that goes beyond ordinary draconic durability. Their scales carry a quiet force that catches, diffuses, and turns aside supernatural pressure before it reaches the body beneath. As a silver dragon matures, that instinct develops into one of the strongest natural magical defenses among true dragons.

entries.name: Argent Ward
entries: The dragon has Advantage on Saving Throws against cantrips and spells of 1st level.

entries.name: Spellward Scales
entries: The dragon has Advantage on Saving Throws against all spells and other magical effects. Spellward Scales supersedes Argent Ward while the dragon is at the Young age category or older.

entries.name: Unbroken Silver Aegis
entries: Magic bends around the elder silver dragon rather than finding easy purchase. Force that should imprison it fractures against its scales. Attempts to banish, bind, or displace it meet a will reinforced by living arcane armor. The dragon retains Magic Resistance and is Immune to Force damage. It has Advantage on checks and Saving Throws made to resist forced teleportation, banishment, magical restraint, magical imprisonment, and forced planar movement. When a magical effect would teleport or banish the dragon against its will, the dragon can use its Reaction to cause that effect to fail against it.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the dragon more than size. Its voice, gaze, posture, and supernatural presence carry the instinctive certainty of an apex creature that has survived centuries. Those who stand before it can feel that history pressing against their courage. At the start of its turn, the dragon can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 180 feet that can see or hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the dragon for 1 minute. The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that dragon's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition.

spellcasting.name: Innate Draconic Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dragon's spellcasting ability is Charisma. Its spell save DC is 23, and it has +15 to hit with spell attacks. It requires no Spellcasting Focus. It can perform Somatic components using its draconic body. It doesn't require Material components that have no listed cost and aren't consumed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes four attacks using any combination of its Bite, Claw, and Tail. The dragon can replace only one of these attacks with the casting of a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Action. The spell is resolved normally and expends a spell slot or use as normal. A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 6d10 + 9} Piercing damage plus {@damage 6d8} Cold damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 6d6 + 9} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 6d8 + 9} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 6d6 + 9} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Cold Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales its breath weapon in a 120-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 25} Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 24d8} Cold damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. Ancient Cold Supremacy applies to this Cold damage.

action.name: Paralyzing Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The dragon exhales paralyzing gas in a 90-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 25} Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendaryHeader: The dragon can take 5 Legendary Actions, choosing from the options below. Only one Legendary Action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dragon regains spent Legendary Actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The dragon makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The dragon makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The dragon makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Cast Cantrip
entries: The dragon casts one cantrip.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 20 feet of the dragon must make a {@dc 25} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d6 + 9} Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn't fall Prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its Fly Speed.

legendary.name: Breath Surge (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The dragon chooses one of its Breath Weapons and rolls one additional d6 to recharge that Breath Weapon. If the chosen Breath Weapon is already available, the dragon can instead immediately use that Breath Weapon.

legendary.name: Cast Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The dragon casts one spell of 5th level or lower that normally has a casting time of 1 Action, expending a spell slot or use as normal.

legendary.name: High Magic (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The dragon casts one spell from Draconic High Magic whose use is still available.
