conditionImmune.note: from effects other than being reduced to 0 Hit Points

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a Saving Throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Draconic Nature
entries: {@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The dragon is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. This trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.
{@b Keen Senses.} The dragon has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The dragon can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the dragon ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The dragon magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 25 or lower, or returns to its true form. The assumed form can be any Size the chosen creature normally possesses.

While transformed, the dragon retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; personality and memories; alignment; Saving Throw proficiencies; Skill proficiencies; languages; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Draconic Magical Instinct; Legendary Resistance; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body.

It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics, including Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Armor Class, movement modes, natural weapons, physical senses, and other body-dependent traits and actions. It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The dragon can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.
Equipment it is wearing or carrying can merge into the new form or remain usable, as the dragon chooses when it transforms.

trait.name: Draconic Magic
entries: {@b Innate Elemental Casting.} When the dragon casts a spell whose primary damage type is Fire, it can cast that spell without Verbal, Somatic, or non-costly Material components.

{@b Ancient Fire Supremacy.} The dragon's Fire damage ignores Fire Resistance. When the dragon deals Fire damage to a creature with Fire Immunity, that Immunity is treated as Fire Resistance, and the dragon then ignores that Resistance. As a result, the dragon's Fire damage affects creatures with Fire Resistance or Fire Immunity without reducing the damage.
{@b Arcane Reclamation.} At the end of a Short Rest, the dragon can recover expended spell slots whose combined spell levels don't exceed 16. It can't recover uses of Draconic High Magic this way.
{@b Draconic Spell List.} Draconic magic grows from instinct and experience. The dragon knows the Gold Dragon spells presented in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait through 9th-level magic.

{@b Draconic At-Will Magic.} The dragon can cast each spell listed under At Will in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait without expending a spell slot and with no usage limit. A leveled spell cast this way is cast at its lowest spell level. The dragon can instead expend a spell slot to cast that spell normally, including to upcast it when applicable. An At-Will spell with a Casting Time of 1 Action can replace the dragon's one permitted spell replacement in Multiattack. Leveled At-Will Magic at this age: {@spell detect magic|XPHB}, {@spell command|XPHB}, {@spell scorching ray|XPHB}, {@spell zone of truth|XPHB}, {@spell fireball|XPHB}, {@spell revivify|XPHB}, {@spell greater restoration|XPHB}, {@spell heal|XPHB}.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The dragon can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell heal|XPHB}, {@spell resurrection|XPHB}, {@spell true resurrection|XPHB}, {@spell holy aura|XPHB}, {@spell wish|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the dragon from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. When cast through Draconic High Magic, the spell doesn't require Material components unless they have a listed cost or are consumed.

trait.name: Crown of the First Dawn
entries: Gold dragons carry something older than rulership and brighter than ordinary flame. Their presence makes courage easier, deception harder, and cruelty far more dangerous. As a Gold Dragon matures, its authority ceases to feel political and begins to feel cosmic.

entries.name: Dawnfire
entries: Whenever the dragon deals Fire damage, it can choose for any portion of that damage to become Radiant damage instead. Whenever it deals both Fire and Radiant damage to the same target during its turn, that target sheds Bright Light for 10 feet until the start of the dragon's next turn. This doesn't automatically reveal an Invisible creature, but it visibly marks the space occupied by a target that was actually hit.

entries.name: Radiant Authority
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon chooses one creature within 60 feet. That creature becomes Judged. Once per turn, when the Judged creature damages another creature, willingly breaks a promise it made to the dragon during this duration, or attempts to harm a creature the dragon explicitly placed under its protection, the dragon can deal {@damage 2d8} + its Charisma modifier Radiant damage to the Judged creature without using an Action. This isn't perfect lie detection; the dragon must actually know or observe the triggering conduct.

entries.name: Sovereign Presence
entries: Chosen allies within 60 feet gain a bonus equal to the dragon's PB to Saving Throws against Charmed and Frightened, have Resistance to Radiant damage, and have Advantage on Death Saving Throws. A hostile creature that starts its turn in the aura while Judged takes Radiant damage equal to the dragon's Charisma modifier + PB.

entries.name: Judgment of the Sun
entries: The dragon can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The dragon chooses one creature within 180 feet. The target must make a {@dc 25} Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target is Condemned for 1 minute. While Condemned, it can't benefit from Fire or Radiant Resistance against the dragon; Fire or Radiant Immunity is treated as Resistance against the dragon; it can't become Invisible to the dragon; and whenever it damages another creature, it takes {@damage 4d10} Radiant damage. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Voice of the Open Horizon
entries: Brass dragons have always treated conversation as something more powerful than claws. Their voices carry intent, emotion, warning, humor, and authority far beyond ordinary speech. As they age, even violence can be interrupted by the simple fact that a Brass Dragon has chosen to speak.

entries.name: Tongue Without Borders
entries: Any creature within 60 feet that knows at least one language can understand the Brass Dragon's spoken words, regardless of what language the dragon actually uses. The dragon similarly understands the general meaning of spoken language it hears, though this doesn't decipher codes, secret meanings, or magically concealed information.

entries.name: Words Before Violence
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. This effect lasts until the start of the triggering creature's next turn. When a creature within 60 feet that can hear the dragon makes an Attack Roll, the dragon can speak a warning, argument, insult, plea, or distraction. The creature makes a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC. On a failure, it has Disadvantage on that attack, can't make Opportunity Attacks, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Command the Conversation
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. On a failure, a creature can't willingly attack the dragon or a creature designated by the dragon until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Taking damage from a protected creature immediately allows another save. This effect isn't Charmed and functions against creatures immune to Charmed.

entries.name: Voice Across Kingdoms
entries: The dragon can deliberately project its voice to any location within 10 miles that it knows. Its speech arrives clearly at the chosen location regardless of intervening terrain. The dragon can choose to speak simultaneously through any number of points within that radius and can choose which creatures at those points hear it. This isn't telepathy and doesn't allow a recipient to answer the dragon automatically.

entries.name: The World Must Hear
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The wyrm creates a 500-foot aura of enforced parley. Before a hostile creature in the aura that can hear the wyrm can make an attack, cast a damaging spell, or use an effect that forces another creature to make a Saving Throw in order to deal damage, it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the wyrm's Spell Save DC. On a failed save, the attempted hostile act expends neither the creature's Action, spell slot, nor limited use, but the creature can't attempt that hostile act again until the start of its next turn. entries: {@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The wyrm is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. This trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.
{@b Keen Senses.} The wyrm has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the wyrm ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The wyrm magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 27 or lower, or returns to its true form.

While transformed, it retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; Saving Throw and Skill proficiencies; languages; personality and memories; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Legendary Resistance; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body. It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics.

It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The wyrm can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The wyrm can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell mislead|XPHB}, {@spell move earth|XPHB}, {@spell reverse gravity|XPHB}, {@spell mirage arcane|XPHB}, {@spell project image|XPHB}, {@spell teleport|XPHB}, {@spell wish|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the wyrm from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. When cast through Draconic High Magic, the spell doesn't require Material components unless they have a listed cost or are consumed.

trait.name: World-Heart Reignition (1/Long Rest)
entries: When the wyrm would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead, it regains Hit Points equal to half its Hit Point maximum; ends any conditions or ongoing effects on itself that it chooses; recharges both of its Breath Weapons; regains 3 expended uses of Legendary Resistance; regains one expended use of Draconic High Magic, including a 9th-level spell; and immediately regains its full allotment of Legendary Actions.

trait.name: The World Plays Along
entries: Copper dragons rarely accept the world exactly as they find it. Stone becomes a stage, distance becomes a joke, and certainty becomes something to be mocked. With age, reality itself seems increasingly willing to participate in the dragon's tricks.

entries.name: Mischievous Ground
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon chooses a 10-foot square of ground within 60 feet and magically alters its texture and shape. It can make the area Difficult Terrain, harmlessly slippery, uneven enough to grant Half Cover to a Small creature, or visually appear slightly different. The alteration isn't permanent.

entries.name: Wrong Step
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 60 feet moves at least 10 feet, the dragon can distort the ground beneath it. The creature must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC. On a failure, the dragon moves it up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space on the same surface, and it falls Prone.

entries.name: Laughing Terrain
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon chooses a 60-foot-radius area within 120 feet and can continuously reshape nonmagical earth and stone there into slopes, shallow pits, waist-high walls, ramps, steps, pillars, or trenches. No single alteration can directly crush a creature or instantly destroy a building. The dragon can rearrange the affected terrain again as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Impossible Shortcut
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. The dragon enters a solid earth or stone surface and emerges from another connected earth or stone surface within 300 feet. Creatures and objects it is carrying travel with it. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks and doesn't require line of sight, provided the two surfaces are connected by earth or stone.

entries.name: Reality Gets the Joke
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature the wyrm can see within 300 feet teleports, is pushed or pulled, moves through magical movement, or creates an Area of Effect, the wyrm can alter the final positioning. It can shift a creature's destination by up to 60 feet or shift the origin point of the Area of Effect by up to 60 feet. The new position must still be legally possible for the original effect. This feature doesn't cancel the original effect.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the dragon more than size. Its voice, gaze, posture, and supernatural presence carry the instinctive certainty of an apex creature that has survived centuries. Those who stand before it can feel that history pressing against their courage. At the start of its turn, the dragon can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 300 feet that can see or hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC.

On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the dragon for 1 minute. The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that dragon's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition. a creature that fails its initial Saving Throw can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
This additional effect occurs only on the initial failed save.

spellcasting.name: Innate Draconic Spellcasting
headerEntries: The wyrm's spellcasting ability is Charisma. Its spell save DC is 25, and it has +17 to hit with spell attacks. It requires no Spellcasting Focus. It can perform Somatic components using its draconic body. It doesn't require Material components that have no listed cost and aren't consumed. When the wyrm casts {@spell chromatic orb|XPHB} through this trait, it can choose only Acid as the spell's damage type.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wyrm makes five attacks using any combination of its Bite, Claw, and Tail. The wyrm can replace only one of these attacks with the casting of a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Action. The spell is resolved normally and expends a spell slot or use as normal. A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 8d10 + 10} Piercing damage plus {@damage 8d8} Acid damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 8d6 + 10} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 35 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 8d8 + 10} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 8d6 + 10} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Acid Breath {@recharge 4}
entries: The wyrm exhales its breath weapon in a 180-foot-long, 20-foot-wide Line. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 27} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 32d8} Acid damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. Wyrm Acid Supremacy applies to this damage.

action.name: Slowing Breath {@recharge 4}
entries: This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The wyrm exhales slowing gas in a 120-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 25} Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, its Speed is halved, it can't take Reactions, it can make only one attack during its turn, and it has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries: Bronze dragons possess an almost compulsive awareness of danger around them. Thunder answers not merely anger, but the decision to stand between harm and another creature. An elder Bronze Dragon doesn't simply endure a battlefield—it controls who is allowed to be hurt within it.

trait.name: Argent Aegis
entries: Silver dragons are born with an instinctive resistance to hostile magic that goes beyond ordinary draconic durability. Their scales carry a quiet force that catches, diffuses, and turns aside supernatural pressure before it reaches the body beneath. As a silver dragon matures, that instinct develops into one of the strongest natural magical defenses among true dragons.

entries.name: Argent Ward
entries: The dragon has Advantage on Saving Throws against cantrips and spells of 1st level.

entries.name: Spellward Scales
entries: The dragon has Advantage on Saving Throws against all spells and other magical effects. Spellward Scales supersedes Argent Ward while the dragon is at the Young age category or older.

entries.name: Unbroken Silver Aegis
entries: Magic bends around the elder silver dragon rather than finding easy purchase. Force that should imprison it fractures against its scales. Attempts to banish, bind, or displace it meet a will reinforced by living arcane armor. The dragon retains Magic Resistance and is Immune to Force damage. It has Advantage on checks and Saving Throws made to resist forced teleportation, banishment, magical restraint, magical imprisonment, and forced planar movement. When a magical effect would teleport or banish the dragon against its will, the dragon can use its Reaction to cause that effect to fail against it.

entries.name: Absolute Argent Aegis
entries: Magic no longer merely struggles against the silver wyrm—it breaks upon it. The invisible architecture of Force bends around its scales like wind around a mountain. Those sheltered beneath its wings share in a defense that even archmages find difficult to penetrate. The wyrm is Immune to Force damage, retains Magic Resistance, and has Resistance to all damage dealt by spells. The wyrm can't be teleported, banished, or moved to another plane against its will.

Chosen creatures within 120 feet have Magic Resistance, Resistance to Force damage, and Advantage on checks and Saving Throws made to resist banishment, forced teleportation, magical restraint, magical imprisonment, and forced planar movement.

entries.name: Argent Refraction
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a spell or magical effect the wyrm can see within 120 feet targets the wyrm or a creature protected by Absolute Argent Aegis, the wyrm can grant that target a +5 bonus to AC against the triggering effect or a +5 bonus to the triggering Saving Throw. If that bonus causes the attack to miss or the Saving Throw to succeed, the wyrm can move the protected creature up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. This Force movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

trait.name: Sanctuary of the Gentle Sky
entries: Silver dragons carry the safety of high mountains and quiet snowfall with them. Their presence turns survival into recovery and fear into calm. The oldest among them can make death itself wait outside the boundaries of their protection.

entries.name: Warmth Beneath the Snow
entries: Creatures chosen by the dragon within 30 feet are protected from natural extreme cold, have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and automatically stabilize after succeeding on one Death Saving Throw.

entries.name: Shelter in the Storm
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. The Temporary Hit Points last until depleted or replaced; condition removal is instantaneous. The dragon chooses a creature within 60 feet. That creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the dragon's PB + its Charisma modifier. The creature can immediately end either the Frightened or Charmed condition on itself.

entries.name: Merciful Intercession

The dragon can then move that creature up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the dragon can see. The dragon can use this Reaction a number of times equal to its PB per Long Rest.

entries.name: Sanctuary Cannot Be Broken
entries: The wyrm can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon creates a 120-foot aura. Chosen creatures in the aura have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, can't have their Hit Point maximum reduced, can't be prevented from regaining Hit Points, and can't be instantly killed while above 0 Hit Points.

entries.name: Death Waits Outside
entries: While Sanctuary Cannot Be Broken is active, the first time each chosen creature would die during that duration, it doesn't die. Instead, it returns to half its Hit Point maximum; ends Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, and Stunned on itself; and can immediately stand without spending movement. Each creature can benefit from this effect only once per use of Sanctuary Cannot Be Broken.

trait.name: Frightful Presence

entries: The greatwyrm chooses one of its Breath Weapons and rolls one additional d6 to recharge that Breath Weapon. If the chosen Breath Weapon is already available, the greatwyrm can instead immediately use that Breath Weapon.

legendary.name: High Magic (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm casts one spell from Draconic High Magic whose use is still available.

mythic.name: Voice Above Violence (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 300 feet that can hear the greatwyrm must make a {@dc 28} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, it can't make Opportunity Attacks, and Attack Rolls it makes before the end of its next turn have Disadvantage.

mythic.name: All Will Hear (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm chooses up to three creatures within 300 feet that can hear it. Each chosen creature must make a {@dc 28} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, that creature can't take hostile Actions or Bonus Actions until the end of its next turn.

mythic.name: Enough (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: Each hostile creature of the greatwyrm's choice within 120 feet that can hear it must make a {@dc 28} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, until the end of its next turn, the creature can't take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions that would damage another creature or force another creature to make a Saving Throw against a damaging effect. This effect isn't Charmed.

conditionImmune.note: from effects other than being reduced to 0 Hit Points

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (9/Day)
entries: If the greatwyrm fails a Saving Throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Draconic Nature
entries: {@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The greatwyrm is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. This trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.
{@b Keen Senses.} The greatwyrm has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the greatwyrm ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The greatwyrm magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 35 or lower, or returns to its true form.

While transformed, it retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; Saving Throw and Skill proficiencies; languages; personality and memories; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Legendary Resistance; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body. It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics.

It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The greatwyrm can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The greatwyrm can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell mislead|XPHB}, {@spell move earth|XPHB}, {@spell reverse gravity|XPHB}, {@spell mirage arcane|XPHB}, {@spell project image|XPHB}, {@spell teleport|XPHB}, {@spell wish|XPHB}, {@spell time stop|XPHB}, and {@spell shapechange|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the greatwyrm from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. When cast through Draconic High Magic, the spell doesn't require Material components unless they have a listed cost or are consumed.

trait.name: The World Laughs Last (1/Long Rest)
entries: When the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead, it regains all of its Hit Points; ends any conditions or ongoing effects on itself that it chooses; recharges both of its Breath Weapons; regains all expended uses of Legendary Resistance; regains all expended uses of Draconic High Magic; and immediately regains its full allotment of Legendary Actions. For 1 hour, space and terrain within 300 feet of the greatwyrm continuously distort around it.

Hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain. The greatwyrm ignores Difficult Terrain and can move through earth and stone without spending extra movement, emerging from any connected surface within the aura. At the start of each of the greatwyrm's turns, both of its Breath Weapons automatically recharge. While The World Laughs Last is active, the greatwyrm can use its Mythic Actions.

trait.name: The World Plays Along
entries: Copper dragons rarely accept the world exactly as they find it. Stone becomes a stage, distance becomes a joke, and certainty becomes something to be mocked. With age, reality itself seems increasingly willing to participate in the dragon's tricks.

entries.name: Mischievous Ground
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon chooses a 10-foot square of ground within 60 feet and magically alters its texture and shape. It can make the area Difficult Terrain, harmlessly slippery, uneven enough to grant Half Cover to a Small creature, or visually appear slightly different. The alteration isn't permanent.

entries.name: Wrong Step
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 60 feet moves at least 10 feet, the dragon can distort the ground beneath it. The creature must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against the dragon's Spell Save DC. On a failure, the dragon moves it up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space on the same surface, and it falls Prone.

entries.name: Laughing Terrain
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon chooses a 60-foot-radius area within 120 feet and can continuously reshape nonmagical earth and stone there into slopes, shallow pits, waist-high walls, ramps, steps, pillars, or trenches. No single alteration can directly crush a creature or instantly destroy a building. The dragon can rearrange the affected terrain again as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Impossible Shortcut
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. The dragon enters a solid earth or stone surface and emerges from another connected earth or stone surface within 300 feet. Creatures and objects it is carrying travel with it. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks and doesn't require line of sight, provided the two surfaces are connected by earth or stone.

entries.name: Reality Gets the Joke
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature the greatwyrm can see within 300 feet teleports, is pushed or pulled, moves through magical movement, or creates an Area of Effect, the greatwyrm can alter the final positioning. It can shift a creature's destination by up to 60 feet or shift the origin point of the Area of Effect by up to 60 feet. The new position must still be legally possible for the original effect. This feature doesn't cancel the original effect.

entries.name: The Rules Are Suggestions
entries: Reality Gets the Joke can affect a creature or effect the greatwyrm can see within 500 feet. The greatwyrm can shift a creature's destination by up to 120 feet, or shift the origin point of an Area of Effect by up to 120 feet. If the effect creates a Line or Cone, the greatwyrm can also change its direction from the new origin. If an effect targets a creature rather than creating an Area of Effect, the greatwyrm can instead replace one target with another legal target within 60 feet of the original target.
The replacement must be a creature or object that the original effect could legally affect. The original effect isn't canceled; reality simply resolves it from the greatwyrm's revised positioning.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the greatwyrm more than size. Its voice, gaze, posture, and supernatural presence carry the instinctive certainty of a creature that has outlived lesser empires. At the start of its turn, the greatwyrm can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the greatwyrm's choice within 500 feet that can see or hear it must make a {@dc 28} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the greatwyrm for 1 minute.

The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that greatwyrm's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition. A creature that fails its initial Saving Throw also can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

When the greatwyrm casts {@spell chromatic orb|XPHB} through this trait, it can choose only Acid as the spell's damage type.

A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 21} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d10 + 11} Piercing damage plus {@damage 10d8} Acid damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 21} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6 + 11} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 21} to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d8 + 11} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 21} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6 + 11} Bludgeoning damage.

On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 40d8} Acid damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. Greatwyrm Acid Supremacy applies to this damage.

action.name: Slowing Breath {@recharge 3}
entries: This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The greatwyrm exhales slowing gas in a 180-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 28} Constitution Saving Throw. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries: Bronze dragons possess an almost compulsive awareness of danger around them. Thunder answers not merely anger, but the decision to stand between harm and another creature. An elder Bronze Dragon doesn't simply endure a battlefield—it controls who is allowed to be hurt within it.

entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 30 feet is hit by an attack, the dragon can impose a penalty equal to its PB on the triggering attack roll, potentially causing it to miss.

entries.name: Storm Interception
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 60 feet is targeted by an attack, the dragon can move up to half its Speed toward that creature without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If physically possible, the dragon places itself between the attacker and target and becomes the target of the attack instead. If the attack hits the dragon, the attacker takes Lightning damage equal to PB × 1d8.

entries.name: Guardian of the Storm
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 120 feet fails a Saving Throw against a spell or magical effect, the dragon can allow it to reroll the Saving Throw. If the reroll succeeds, lightning strikes the source of the effect, dealing {@damage 4d10} Lightning damage to it.

entries.name: Storm Answers Harm
entries: This effect lasts until the end of the dragon's next turn. Whenever a creature within 120 feet damages one of the dragon's chosen allies, that attacker becomes Storm-Marked until the end of the dragon's next turn. The first time the dragon damages that creature while it is Storm-Marked, it takes an additional {@damage 6d10} Lightning damage, can't take Reactions, and has its Speed halved until the end of the dragon's next turn.

If it ends this movement within 30 feet of that creature, the creature drops to 1 Hit Point instead and gains 58 Temporary Hit Points. The source that dealt the triggering damage is then struck by lightning and takes {@damage 10d10} Lightning damage. This feature doesn't require the greatwyrm to cast a spell.

entries.name: I Decide Who Falls
entries: Once per round, when a chosen creature the greatwyrm can see within 500 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, that creature drops to 1 Hit Point instead and gains 80 Temporary Hit Points. This effect requires no Action or Reaction. The source that dealt the triggering damage is immediately struck by lightning and takes {@damage 12d10} Lightning damage. conditionImmune.note: from effects other than being reduced to 0 Hit Points

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (9/Day)
entries: If the greatwyrm fails a Saving Throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Draconic Magic
entries: {@b Greatwyrm Magic Resistance.} The greatwyrm has Advantage on Saving Throws against spells and other magical effects. Spell attack rolls against the greatwyrm are made with Disadvantage.
{@b Perfect Concentration.} The greatwyrm automatically succeeds on Constitution Saving Throws made to maintain Concentration as a result of taking damage.
{@b Innate Elemental Casting.} When the greatwyrm casts a spell whose primary damage type is Cold, it can cast that spell without Verbal, Somatic, or non-costly Material components.

{@b Greatwyrm Cold Supremacy.} The greatwyrm's Cold damage ignores Resistance and Immunity to Cold damage. An effect that would absorb, redirect, convert, or turn the greatwyrm's Cold damage into healing can't do so. The damage is dealt normally instead. Effects that reduce damage without depending on its damage type function normally.
{@b Perfect High Magic Recovery.} At the end of a Short Rest, the greatwyrm regains one expended use of Draconic High Magic. This can restore an expended use of a 9th-level spell.
{@b Arcane Reclamation.} At the end of a Short Rest, the greatwyrm can recover expended spell slots whose combined spell levels don't exceed 30. It can't recover uses of Draconic High Magic this way.

{@b Draconic Spell List.} Draconic magic grows from instinct and experience. The greatwyrm knows every spell presented in its Silver Dragon spell list through 9th-level magic, as shown in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait.

{@b Draconic At-Will Magic.} The greatwyrm can cast each spell listed under At Will in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting trait without expending a spell slot and with no usage limit. A leveled spell cast this way is cast at its lowest spell level. The greatwyrm can instead expend a spell slot to cast that spell normally, including to upcast it when applicable. An At-Will spell with a Casting Time of 1 Action can replace the greatwyrm's one permitted spell replacement in Multiattack. Leveled At-Will Magic at this age: {@spell detect magic|XPHB}, {@spell fog cloud|XPHB}, {@spell lesser restoration|XPHB}, {@spell misty step|XPHB}, {@spell revivify|XPHB}, {@spell freedom of movement|XPHB}, {@spell wall of force|XPHB}, {@spell globe of invulnerability|XPHB}, {@spell forcecage|XPHB}, {@spell holy aura|XPHB}.

trait.name: Draconic Nature
entries: {@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The greatwyrm is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. This trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.
{@b Keen Senses.} The greatwyrm has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the greatwyrm ends it, uses this feature again, or dies. The greatwyrm magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 38 or lower, or returns to its true form.

While transformed, it retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; Saving Throw and Skill proficiencies; languages; personality and memories; Innate Draconic Spellcasting; Legendary Resistance; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body. It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics.

It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The greatwyrm can continue using its own draconic spellcasting while transformed.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The greatwyrm can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell globe of invulnerability|XPHB}, {@spell Fizban's platinum shield|FTD}, {@spell forcecage|XPHB}, {@spell antimagic field|XPHB}, {@spell mass heal|XPHB}, {@spell true resurrection|XPHB}, {@spell wish|XPHB}, {@spell foresight|XPHB}, and {@spell time stop|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the greatwyrm from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. When cast through Draconic High Magic, the spell doesn't require Material components unless they have a listed cost or are consumed.

trait.name: The Gentle Sky Eternal (1/Long Rest)
entries: When the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead, it regains all of its Hit Points; ends any conditions or ongoing effects on itself that it chooses; recharges both of its Breath Weapons; regains all expended uses of Legendary Resistance; regains all expended uses of Draconic High Magic; and immediately regains its full allotment of Legendary Actions. For 1 hour, a 300-foot sanctuary aura surrounds the greatwyrm and moves with it.

Chosen creatures in the aura have Magic Resistance and Resistance to all damage dealt by spells. At the start of a chosen creature's turn, it regains 30 Hit Points and can end one of the following conditions on itself: Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, or Stunned. Chosen creatures in the aura can't be reduced below 1 Hit Point by damage while the greatwyrm remains conscious. At the start of each of the greatwyrm's turns, both of its Breath Weapons automatically recharge.
While The Gentle Sky Eternal is active, the greatwyrm can use its Mythic Actions.

trait.name: Argent Aegis
entries: Silver dragons are born with an instinctive resistance to hostile magic that goes beyond ordinary draconic durability. Their scales carry a quiet force that catches, diffuses, and turns aside supernatural pressure before it reaches the body beneath. As a silver dragon matures, that instinct develops into one of the strongest natural magical defenses among true dragons.

entries.name: Argent Ward
entries: The dragon has Advantage on Saving Throws against cantrips and spells of 1st level.

entries.name: Spellward Scales
entries: The dragon has Advantage on Saving Throws against all spells and other magical effects. Spellward Scales supersedes Argent Ward while the dragon is at the Young age category or older.

entries.name: Unbroken Silver Aegis
entries: Magic bends around the elder silver dragon rather than finding easy purchase. Force that should imprison it fractures against its scales. Attempts to banish, bind, or displace it meet a will reinforced by living arcane armor. The dragon retains Magic Resistance and is Immune to Force damage. It has Advantage on checks and Saving Throws made to resist forced teleportation, banishment, magical restraint, magical imprisonment, and forced planar movement. When a magical effect would teleport or banish the dragon against its will, the dragon can use its Reaction to cause that effect to fail against it.

entries.name: Absolute Argent Aegis
entries: Magic no longer merely struggles against the silver wyrm—it breaks upon it. The invisible architecture of Force bends around its scales like wind around a mountain. Those sheltered beneath its wings share in a defense that even archmages find difficult to penetrate. The greatwyrm is Immune to Force damage, retains Magic Resistance, and has Resistance to all damage dealt by spells. The greatwyrm can't be teleported, banished, or moved to another plane against its will.

Chosen creatures within 120 feet have Magic Resistance, Resistance to Force damage, and Advantage on checks and Saving Throws made to resist banishment, forced teleportation, magical restraint, magical imprisonment, and forced planar movement.

entries.name: Argent Refraction
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a spell or magical effect the greatwyrm can see within 120 feet targets the greatwyrm or a creature protected by Absolute Argent Aegis, the greatwyrm can grant that target a +5 bonus to AC against the triggering effect or a +5 bonus to the triggering Saving Throw. If that bonus causes the attack to miss or the Saving Throw to succeed, the greatwyrm can move the protected creature up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. This Force movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

entries.name: Magic Breaks Before the Sky
entries: The greatwyrm is Immune to Force damage and has Resistance to all damage dealt by spells. It can't be teleported, banished, magically restrained, magically imprisoned, or moved to another plane against its will. Chosen creatures within 300 feet have Magic Resistance, Resistance to Force damage, and Resistance to all damage dealt by spells. Argent Refraction grants a +7 bonus instead of +5. If that bonus causes a spell attack to miss or a Saving Throw against a spell to succeed, a spell of 8th level or lower has no further effect on the protected creature.

trait.name: Sanctuary of the Gentle Sky
entries: Silver dragons carry the safety of high mountains and quiet snowfall with them. Their presence turns survival into recovery and fear into calm. The oldest among them can make death itself wait outside the boundaries of their protection.

entries.name: Warmth Beneath the Snow
entries: Creatures chosen by the dragon within 30 feet are protected from natural extreme cold, have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and automatically stabilize after succeeding on one Death Saving Throw.

entries.name: Shelter in the Storm
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. The Temporary Hit Points last until depleted or replaced; condition removal is instantaneous. The dragon chooses a creature within 60 feet. That creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the dragon's PB + its Charisma modifier. The creature can immediately end either the Frightened or Charmed condition on itself.

entries.name: Merciful Intercession
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Reaction. When a creature within 120 feet would drop to 0 Hit Points, the dragon can cause it to drop to 1 Hit Point instead. The dragon can then move that creature up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the dragon can see. The dragon can use this Reaction a number of times equal to its PB per Long Rest.

entries.name: Sanctuary Cannot Be Broken
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon creates a 120-foot aura. Chosen creatures in the aura have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, can't have their Hit Point maximum reduced, can't be prevented from regaining Hit Points, and can't be instantly killed while above 0 Hit Points.

entries.name: Death Waits Outside
entries: While Sanctuary Cannot Be Broken is active, the first time each chosen creature would die during that duration, it doesn't die. Instead, it returns to half its Hit Point maximum; ends Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, and Stunned on itself; and can immediately stand without spending movement. Each creature can benefit from this effect only once per use of Sanctuary Cannot Be Broken.

entries.name: Death Has No Permission Here
entries: While Sanctuary Cannot Be Broken is active, its radius becomes 300 feet. A chosen creature in the aura can't be reduced below 1 Hit Point by damage while the greatwyrm is conscious and within the aura. The creature can still be Incapacitated, transformed, banished, or affected by other effects normally unless another Greatwyrm feature prevents it.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the greatwyrm more than size. Its voice, gaze, posture, and supernatural presence carry the instinctive certainty of a creature that has outlived lesser empires. At the start of its turn, the greatwyrm can activate this feature. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. Each creature of the greatwyrm's choice within 500 feet that can see or hear it must make a {@dc 30} Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the greatwyrm for 1 minute.

The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that greatwyrm's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition. A creature that fails its initial Saving Throw also can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Innate Draconic Spellcasting
headerEntries: The greatwyrm's spellcasting ability is Charisma. Its spell save DC is 30, and it has +22 to hit with spell attacks. It requires no Spellcasting Focus. It can perform Somatic components using its draconic body. It doesn't require Material components that have no listed cost and aren't consumed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The greatwyrm makes six attacks using any combination of its Bite, Claw, and Tail. The greatwyrm can replace only one of these attacks with the casting of a spell that normally has a Casting Time of 1 Action. The spell is resolved normally and expends a spell slot or use as normal. A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 23} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d10 + 12} Piercing damage plus {@damage 10d8} Cold damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 23} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6 + 12} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 23} to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d8 + 12} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 23} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6 + 12} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Cold Breath {@recharge 3}
entries: The greatwyrm exhales its breath weapon in a 240-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 31} Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 40d8} Cold damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. Greatwyrm Cold Supremacy applies to this damage.

action.name: Paralyzing Breath {@recharge 3}
entries: This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The greatwyrm exhales paralyzing gas in a 180-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 31} Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendaryHeader: The greatwyrm can take 9 Legendary Actions, choosing from the options below. Only one Legendary Action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The greatwyrm regains spent Legendary Actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The greatwyrm makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The greatwyrm makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Cast Cantrip
entries: The greatwyrm casts one cantrip.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the greatwyrm must make a {@dc 31} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d6 + 12} Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn't fall Prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its Fly Speed.

legendary.name: Cataclysmic Movement (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm moves up to its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature the greatwyrm passes within 25 feet of during this movement must succeed on a {@dc 31} Dexterity Saving Throw or fall Prone.

legendary.name: Cast Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm casts one spell of 8th level or lower that normally has a Casting Time of 1 Action, expending a spell slot or use as normal.

legendary.name: Breath Surge (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm chooses one of its Breath Weapons and rolls one additional d6 to recharge that Breath Weapon. If the chosen Breath Weapon is already available, the greatwyrm can instead immediately use that Breath Weapon.

legendary.name: High Magic (Costs 5 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm casts one spell from Draconic High Magic whose use is still available.

mythicHeader: While The Gentle Sky Eternal is active, the greatwyrm can use the following Mythic Actions as additional Legendary Action options. They expend Legendary Actions from the greatwyrm's normal pool.

mythic.name: Shelter the Living (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One chosen creature within 300 feet gains 60 Temporary Hit Points and can immediately move up to 60 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

mythic.name: Break the Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The greatwyrm chooses one spell of 8th level or lower producing an ongoing effect within 180 feet. That spell ends.

trait.name: Crown of the First Dawn
entries: Gold dragons carry something older than rulership and brighter than ordinary flame. Their presence makes courage easier, deception harder, and cruelty far more dangerous. As a Gold Dragon matures, its authority ceases to feel political and begins to feel cosmic.

entries.name: Dawnfire
entries: Whenever the dragon deals Fire damage, it can choose for any portion of that damage to become Radiant damage instead. Whenever it deals both Fire and Radiant damage to the same target during its turn, that target sheds Bright Light for 10 feet until the start of the dragon's next turn. This doesn't automatically reveal an Invisible creature, but it visibly marks the space occupied by a target that was actually hit.

entries.name: Radiant Authority
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon chooses one creature within 60 feet. That creature becomes Judged. Once per turn, when the Judged creature damages another creature, willingly breaks a promise it made to the dragon during this duration, or attempts to harm a creature the dragon explicitly placed under its protection, the dragon can deal {@damage 2d8} + its Charisma modifier Radiant damage to the Judged creature without using an Action. This isn't perfect lie detection; the dragon must actually know or observe the triggering conduct.

entries.name: Sovereign Presence
entries: Chosen allies within 60 feet gain a bonus equal to the dragon's PB to Saving Throws against Charmed and Frightened, have Resistance to Radiant damage, and have Advantage on Death Saving Throws. A hostile creature that starts its turn in the aura while Judged takes Radiant damage equal to the dragon's Charisma modifier + PB.

entries.name: Judgment of the Sun
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as an Action. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The dragon chooses one creature within 180 feet. The target must make a {@dc 25} Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target is Condemned for 1 minute. While Condemned, it can't benefit from Fire or Radiant Resistance against the dragon; Fire or Radiant Immunity is treated as Resistance against the dragon; it can't become Invisible to the dragon; and whenever it damages another creature, it takes {@damage 4d10} Radiant damage. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Crown of the First Dawn
entries: The greatwyrm can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The greatwyrm emits sunlight in a 300-foot radius. Chosen allies in the sunlight have Resistance to all damage from spells, regain 20 Hit Points at the start of each of their turns, and can't be Charmed or Frightened. Hostile creatures in the sunlight can't benefit from Fire or Radiant Resistance against the greatwyrm.

Fire and Radiant Immunity are treated as Resistance against the greatwyrm, and hostile creatures have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against the greatwyrm's Fire or Radiant effects. When the greatwyrm uses its Fire Breath, it can convert any portion of that damage to Radiant damage.

entries.name: Dawn Without End
entries: When the greatwyrm activates Crown of the First Dawn, its radius becomes 500 feet. Chosen allies in the sunlight have Resistance to all damage, regain 30 Hit Points at the start of each of their turns, and can't be Charmed or Frightened. They have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against the greatwyrm's Fire and Radiant effects. trait.name: Change Shape
entries: A young gem dragon has learned to translate thought into more than motion. Its mind can impose a different physical pattern upon its body without surrendering the psionic identity beneath. The adopted shape is a body, not a replacement for the dragon's memories, magic, or will. The dragon can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the dragon ends it, uses this feature again, or dies.

The dragon magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 12 or lower, or returns to its true form. The assumed form can be any Size the chosen creature normally possesses.

While transformed, the dragon retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; personality and memories; alignment; Saving Throw proficiencies; Skill proficiencies; languages; Innate Draconic Spellcasting (Psionics); Psionic Mind; Psychic Step; Draconic Magical Instinct; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body.

It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics, including Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Armor Class, movement modes, natural weapons, physical senses, and other body-dependent traits and actions. It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The dragon can continue using its own psionic spellcasting while transformed.
Equipment it is wearing or carrying can merge into the new form or remain usable, as the dragon chooses when it transforms.

entries: The area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures, their jump distance is quartered, and a hostile flying creature that starts its turn in the Domain must make a Strength Saving Throw against the dragon's Psionic Save DC. On a failed save, it descends up to 30 feet.

entries.name: Liberating Gravity
entries: Chosen creatures in the Domain gain 10 feet of Speed, have their jump distance tripled, take no falling damage, and have Advantage on Saving Throws against being Grappled or Restrained by effects caused by physical force. As a Bonus Action, the dragon can move the center of the Domain up to 30 feet. The dragon can have only one Gravitational Domain at a time.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks using any combination of its Bite, Claw, and Tail. entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 3d10 + 6} Piercing damage plus {@damage 3d8} Force damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 3d6 + 6} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 3d8 + 6} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Singularity Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The Speed and teleportation restrictions last until the start of the dragon's next turn. The dragon exhales gravitational force in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 14d8} Force damage, its Speed becomes 0, and it can't teleport until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effect.

trait.name: Draconic Nature
entries: {@b Growing Draconic Mind.} The dragon is no longer merely a gifted child. Experience has begun turning instinct into judgment, curiosity into expertise, and raw psionic talent into deliberate technique. It can now pursue plans that last months or years rather than moments. A Young Gem Dragon can plan ahead, study magic and psionics, make agreements, manage territory, and understand social structures far better than a wyrmling, though it still lacks the accumulated experience of an Adult Dragon.

{@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The dragon is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. This trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.
{@b Keen Senses.} The dragon has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

{@b Psionic Mind.} Thought flows as naturally as breath. The dragon can communicate telepathically with a creature it can see within 120 feet. A contacted creature can understand the dragon if it knows at least one language, and it can reply telepathically while it remains within 120 feet of the dragon.

trait.name: Psychic Step
entries: Gem dragons don't always cross distance by moving through it. Their crystalline bodies can briefly become an extension of thought rather than matter. With maturity, a destination seen by the mind can become a destination reached by the body. The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. The dragon teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. This isn't a spell and requires no components. The dragon can use Psychic Step without a usage limit. Only the dragon and objects it is wearing or carrying teleport. A creature being carried by the dragon doesn't teleport with it.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: A young gem dragon has learned to translate thought into more than motion. Its mind can impose a different physical pattern upon its body without surrendering the psionic identity beneath. The adopted shape is a body, not a replacement for the dragon's memories, magic, or will. The dragon can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the dragon ends it, uses this feature again, or dies.

The dragon magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 9 or lower, or returns to its true form. The assumed form can be any Size the chosen creature normally possesses.

While transformed, the dragon retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; personality and memories; alignment; Saving Throw proficiencies; Skill proficiencies; languages; Innate Draconic Spellcasting (Psionics); Psionic Mind; Psychic Step; Draconic Magical Instinct; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body.

It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics, including Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Armor Class, movement modes, natural weapons, physical senses, and other body-dependent traits and actions. It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The dragon can continue using its own psionic spellcasting while transformed.
Equipment it is wearing or carrying can merge into the new form or remain usable, as the dragon chooses when it transforms.

entries: Crystal dragon magic doesn't merely illuminate—it reinforces life and possibility. entries.name: Entropic Field
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The dragon creates a 30-foot aura. Material components that have a listed cost or are consumed are still required normally.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks using any combination of its Bite, Claw, and Tail. The dragon can replace only one of these attacks with the casting of a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Action. The spell is resolved normally and expends a spell slot or use as normal. A spell cast through Draconic High Magic can also replace that one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 3d10 + 4} Piercing damage plus {@damage 3d6} Necrotic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 3d6 + 4} Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 3d8 + 4} Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Desiccating Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: This effect lasts for up to 1 minute. The dragon exhales desiccating necrotic force in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 17} Constitution Saving Throw. monster.name: Adult Crystal Dragon

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a Saving Throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Draconic Nature
entries: {@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The dragon is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. This trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.
{@b Keen Senses.} The dragon has Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

{@b Psionic Mind.} Thought flows as naturally as breath. The dragon can communicate telepathically with a creature it can see within 120 feet. A contacted creature can understand the dragon if it knows at least one language, and it can reply telepathically while it remains within 120 feet of the dragon.

trait.name: Psychic Step
entries: Gem dragons don't always cross distance by moving through it. Their crystalline bodies can briefly become an extension of thought rather than matter. With maturity, a destination seen by the mind can become a destination reached by the body. The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. The dragon teleports up to 90 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. When it teleports, the dragon can choose one willing creature within 10 feet of it.

That creature teleports with the dragon and appears in an unoccupied space adjacent to it. This isn't a spell and requires no components. The dragon can use Psychic Step without a usage limit. Objects worn or carried by the dragon teleport with it normally.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: An adult gem dragon can impose a different physical pattern upon its body without surrendering the psionic identity beneath. Its transformed body is a chosen vessel rather than a replacement for the mind, memories, or magic that define the dragon. Even while wearing another shape, its thought remains unmistakably draconic. The dragon can use this feature as an Action. The transformation lasts until the dragon ends it, uses this feature again, or dies.

The dragon magically assumes the form of a Humanoid or Beast whose Challenge Rating is 16 or lower, or returns to its true form. The assumed form can be any Size the chosen creature normally possesses.

While transformed, the dragon retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points and Hit Dice; personality and memories; alignment; Saving Throw proficiencies; Skill proficiencies; languages; Innate Draconic Spellcasting (Psionics); Psionic Mind; Psychic Step; Draconic Magical Instinct; Legendary Resistance; and other mental or magical traits that don't specifically require its true draconic body.

It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics, including Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Armor Class, movement modes, natural weapons, physical senses, and other body-dependent traits and actions. It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The dragon can continue using its own psionic spellcasting while transformed.
Equipment it is wearing or carrying can merge into the new form or remain usable, as the dragon chooses when it transforms.

trait.name: Draconic Magic
entries: {@b Superior Radiant Affinity.} The dragon's Radiant damage ignores Radiant Resistance. When the dragon deals Radiant damage to a creature with Radiant Immunity, that Immunity is treated as Radiant Resistance.
{@b Arcane Reclamation.} At the end of a Short Rest, the dragon can recover expended spell slots whose combined spell levels don't exceed 5. It can't recover uses of Draconic High Magic this way.

{@b Draconic Spell List.} Draconic magic grows from instinct and experience. The dragon knows the listed Crystal Dragon spells through 7-level magic, as presented in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting (Psionics) trait.

{@b Draconic At-Will Magic.} The dragon can cast each spell listed under At Will in its Innate Draconic Spellcasting (Psionics) trait without expending a spell slot and with no usage limit. A leveled spell cast this way is cast at its lowest spell level. The dragon can instead expend a spell slot to cast that spell normally, including to upcast it when applicable. An At-Will spell with a Casting Time of 1 Action can replace the dragon's one permitted spell replacement in Multiattack. Leveled At-Will Magic at this age: {@spell detect magic|XPHB}, {@spell sanctuary|XPHB}, {@spell guiding bolt|XPHB}, {@spell lesser restoration|XPHB}, {@spell revivify|XPHB}, {@spell death ward|XPHB}.

trait.name: Draconic High Magic
entries: The dragon can cast each of the following spells once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot: {@spell greater restoration|XPHB}, {@spell heal|XPHB}, {@spell resurrection|XPHB}. Casting a spell this way doesn't prevent the dragon from casting the same spell again using a spell slot. When cast through Draconic High Magic, the spell doesn't require Material components unless they have a listed cost or are consumed.

entries: Crystal dragon magic doesn't merely illuminate—it reinforces life and possibility. entries.name: Reflected Vitality
entries: The Temporary Hit Points persist until depleted or replaced. entries.name: Shielding Light
entries: Reduce the triggering damage by {@damage 3d8} + the dragon's Charisma modifier.

entries.name: Guiding Light
entries: The target rerolls the failed Saving Throw and must use the new result. If Shielding Light reduces the triggering damage to 0, or if the reroll from Guiding Light succeeds, the target gains 12 Temporary Hit Points. The dragon can use Shared Brilliance a number of times equal to its PB per Long Rest.

entries.name: Distributed Presence
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. This effect lasts for 1 minute. When the dragon uses False Presence, it can maintain a number of duplicates at once equal to its PB (6 for this adult dragon). Each duplicate occupies its own position and can serve as an origin for the dragon's telepathy, Illusion spells, and mind- or perception-targeting spells as described by False Presence. When the dragon uses a Bonus Action to move its duplicates, each duplicate can move up to 40 feet.

entries.name: Swap the Thought
entries: The dragon can use this feature as a Reaction. When the dragon is targeted by an attack or fails a Saving Throw, it can swap positions with one of its duplicates within 120 feet. The chosen duplicate then disappears. For an attack, resolve the attack using the dragon's new position. For an Area of Effect, use the new position to determine whether the dragon remains in the area. This is psionic displacement, not the casting of a teleportation spell.

trait.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Age has given the dragon more than size. Its voice, gaze, posture, and supernatural presence carry the instinctive certainty of an apex creature that has survived centuries. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet that can see or hear it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw against the dragon's Psionic Save DC.

On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the dragon for 1 minute. The creature repeats the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save, or for which the effect ends, is immune to that dragon's Frightful Presence for 24 hours. This feature doesn't bypass immunity to the Frightened condition.

entries: {@b Draconic Magical Instinct.} The dragon is proficient in Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}). It can make Arcana checks concerning spells, magical effects, Magic Items, curses, wards, magical creatures, and supernatural phenomena. This trait doesn't grant automatic or complete knowledge.

trait.name: Psychic Step
entries: Gem dragons don't always cross distance by moving through it. Their crystalline bodies can briefly become an extension of thought rather than matter. With maturity, a destination seen by the mind can become a destination reached by the body. The dragon can use this feature as a Bonus Action. It otherwise gains the assumed form's physical characteristics, including Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Armor Class, movement modes, natural weapons, physical senses, and other body-dependent traits and actions. It doesn't gain the assumed form's Spellcasting, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, Mythic Actions, Legendary Resistance, class levels, or class features. The dragon can continue using its own psionic spellcasting while transformed.
Equipment it is wearing or carrying can merge into the new form or remain usable, as the dragon chooses when it transforms.
